text: こまるなー　きみ　いっつも　うみを　あらして！

structure.jp: いっつも　うみを　あらして！

patterns.name: 〜て (reason)
patterns.explanation: The て-form here gives the reason for the complaint, which was said first. うみを　あらして = 'because you keep tearing up the sea'.

patterns.name: 〜な (feeling)
patterns.explanation: な drawn out at the end of a sentence lets out the speaker's own feeling. こまるなー = 'this is a real bother'.
